text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyoooone, thank youuu!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "We just performed 'UNLIMITED IMPACT'!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I think everyone's already noticed, but 
sooooo many people showed up today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When I asked the staff earlier, they said 
that including the live viewings... it's 
five times more than last year! Isn't that 
amazing!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And the number is... roughly the same as 
last year's Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooh?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously, Oi Racecourse seems to be way, 
waaaay over capacity!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We had a big screen set up outside on 
short notice, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone out there, are you having a 
blast~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank youuu☆ I can hear all of your 
voices!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And finally—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh, what, a blackout—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzzt...)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh... The President? V-Video footage...? 
Why?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Look at this—!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Could it be, everyone is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—Hello, Smart Falcon. If you're watching 
this video right now, that means...”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"—In all likelihood, I am probably no 
longer in this world."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Which was, of course, a joke. I heard 
it was trendy, so I decided to try it 
out."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, now that your nerves have 
settled... Allow me the privilege of 
providing the opening act."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"‘To the center of dirt... no, the center 
of the entire Umamusume world, Smart 
Falcon. To you, who kept looking 
single-mindedly forward, we offer our 
deepest gratitude—’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Video footage suddenly projected onto the 
screen. It was the very chronicle of the 
path Smart Falcon had walked thus far.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
"To think I'd see this racecourse packed 
beyond capacity once again..."

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
"And it brought in way more spectators 
than before... I'm truly grateful to 
Falcon-san."

text_block_list.name: Dirt Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I was always watching you from behind, 
Falco-senpai. Even though I could never 
catch up to you."

text_block_list.name: Dirt Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"‘I'll work even harder. Next time, I'm 
taking center stage on the dirt!’"

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"I've been watching over you ever since 
your debut stage. Seeing my favorite stand 
on such a massive stage makes me so 
incredibly happy!"

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Chasing after your sparkle brought me to 
the most breathtaking view. Thank you for 
bringing me here, Falco!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flash...)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Are you crying~?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...! Ahaha, too bad!☆ Falco doesn't cry on 
stage♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, are my eyes tearing up? Of course 
they are, geez...☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because Falco has been dreaming of this... 
forever and ever.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, take a look around you. It's so 
breathtakingly beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
At first, I thought dirt racing wasn't for 
me. But when I ran, the sand was sparkling 
so brightly.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I ran, ran, and ran on the 
dirt— and finally arrived at the view I'm 
sharing with everyone today.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You know, Falco has always dreamed of this 
light. In front of everyone, forever and 
eve~r—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to sparkle... super bright!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...*gasp*.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco is shining! Right now, I'm totally 
being the ultimate umadol~~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I should be the one thanking you. For 
making Falco's dream come true...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank youuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"UNLIMITED IMPACT" today... I've sung it 
over and over again countless times.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The calls grew more passionate with every 
song! It's always amazing, but... today 
was the best of all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just like the title says, today's stage 
will surely... remain in everyone's hearts 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—You're a witness now☆ Don't you ever 
forget it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And with that, today's center was! Smart 
Falcon~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Smart Falcon became a top Umadol 
in both name and reality—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hold on a sec~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Your voices are way too quiet, everyone! 
Falco can't end things like that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"You can make more noise than that, right? 
You can shout way, waaaay louder, can't 
you~~?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Good job-☆ Now, keeping that same energy—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let out all your voices and feelings! Give 
it your all! Hit Falco with everything 
you've got~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, this is really, truly the end! 
We'll say goodbye with our usual cheer!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... Alright!! Here I gooooo☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: When Falco runs away~~?!
choice_data_list: I just gotta chase after them!!!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank youuu♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Catch me with your big love☆ The ultimate 
Umadol, Smart Falcon, signing offfff~~!!
